csvOutput.title: Sales Forecast Team Data Snapshot Summary CSV
csvOutput.description: Three-section CSV. '## Team Rollup (Reps)': the rep-derived rollup (direct reports' submitted values summed per category, EXCLUDING the manager's own submission/deals), as two tables — an overview row (ForecastingPeriod, QuotaValue = summed rep quota, CurrencyIsoCode; blank for quantity-based types) and one category row per family (Category = CommitForecast/BestCaseForecast, SubmittedValue = summed rep-submitted total this cycle, PriorSubmittedValue, WeekOverWeekDelta; the two Prior/Delta cells are blank on the team's first cycle). '## Submission Compliance': SubmittedCount, TotalCount, NotSubmittedReps (the outstanding reps as a ';'-separated list of display names, falling back to the raw user id when a name could not be resolved). '## Team Member Breakdown': one row per report with UserId, UserName (the rep's display name, e.g. Jane Smith; blank when it could not be resolved), TerritoryId (the member's territory id for territory-hierarchy types; blank otherwise), TerritoryName (the member's territory display name for territory-hierarchy types; blank otherwise), Category, PipelineValue, PipelineValueWithoutAdjustments, PriorPipelineValue, PriorPipelineOwnerOnly, SubmissionStatus, LastSubmissionDate, SubmittedValue, PriorSubmittedValue (that rep's prior-cycle submission; blank when none), SubmissionNote, AdjustmentNote. Values are currency amounts for amount-based types, unit quantities for quantity-based. Summarize in natural language; render only values present. No deal-level or opportunity-score data.
